title: Bridge, snap-in bar over a soft part
summary: For a part that can't be hooked: a LiPo pouch, anything soft or without an edge. Two posts stand on the carrier either side of it, and a separate printed bar snaps down into them with a pad of foam stuck under it. The bar's ends sit on the post tops, so the squeeze is set by the posts; a barb on each foot catches under a lip. Press a barb in with a thumbnail to release.
firstUsed: Controller project (2026): controller base, over the 602530 pack

views.label: How it goes on
views.caption: A 602530 pack in its cradle on a 4 × 5 carrier, posts 36.5 apart. Drag the slider to snap the bar down: each foot drops into its slot, the barb rides over the lip and catches under it, and the bar's ends land on the post tops, 8 above the carrier. A 3 mm foam pad under the bar (not shown) is squashed by 1 onto the pack. Cut open from the side to see a foot in its slot.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four pairs of posts on one strip, marked with 1 to 4 engraved dots, at foot clearances 0.1 to 0.4. Each pair's bar is printed beside it on its back, feet up, joined to the strip by a 0.4 × 0.8 sprue: twist it off, snap it in, press a barb to take it out.

specs.title: The bar
rows: span + 5.5: flush with the posts' outer faces
h = part top + 2; bar top at h + 2
specs.note: One print per bridge, on its back: top face down, feet up, no supports. The catch face is a 0.7 overhang, which a 0.4 nozzle prints.

specs.title: The posts
rows: mouth 1.6 wide for 1.5 deep, then 2.3 wide so the foot can flex
from 2.7 above the carrier to h; open below, where the barb shows
specs.badgeNote: barb reach and foot clearance are set by the fit piece

specs.title: Sizes
rows: any: brSpanFor(width of the part and its holder)
specs.note: Nothing in the bridge knows what is under it: size the span from the holder's outside and the height from the part's top.

checks: Twist the bar off its sprue; does it come away clean?
Push it down: does it click at both ends, without forcing?
Does it sit on the post tops without rocking or sliding along the span?
Lift it by the middle: do both barbs hold?
Press one barb in with a thumbnail: does that end lift? Squeeze both: does the bar come off whole?
Five times in and out: has a foot whitened or cracked?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, PETG.
